screened_but_not_ranked.name: MetaGlyph

screened_but_not_ranked.name: XBridge
screened_but_not_ranked.reason: On a 200-item short-context HotpotQA setup, natural-language latency is 1.70 s and XBridge 0.15 s, 11.33x faster. It transfers the mapped full sender context and full hidden-state sequence rather than a compact payload; Apache-2.0 repo 58845e01aee68ee587d57f6663421857bcf81f50 plus one checkpoint/eval cache supports only partial reproduction.

screened_but_not_ranked.name: StateBridge
screened_but_not_ranked.publication_status: COLM 2026 paper according to the primary paper
screened_but_not_ranked.reason: The sender autoregressively decodes its full message before sending 64 aligned final-layer hidden states. The paper reports accuracy but no measured token, latency, FLOP, memory-byte, or wire-byte result; Apache-2.0 repo 3f6bf5442c6e8848555a6132516e6d36f35444fb therefore does not supply an efficiency record.

screened_but_not_ranked.name: Q-KVComm
screened_but_not_ranked.reason: Mixed 4/6/8-bit quantization plus selecting 70% of layers yields calculated KV footprint ratios near 6.93x, 5.69x, and 5.07x, but quality is heuristic semantic similarity rather than answer accuracy and there is no exact physical byte ledger, timing protocol, hardware, or official code.

required_ledgers: negotiation, repair, retry, and fallback cost
claim_gate.success_rule: Pre-register a non-inferiority margin no wider than one absolute percentage point for the primary task metric, require the lower confidence bound to clear it, and fail closed on semantic, provenance, authorization, unit, or safety violations.
claim_gate.unseen_partner_rule: Evaluate at least two held-out model families or providers that did not participate in format induction, and compare total task success and total cost against the best enabled fallback.
claim_gate.release_rule: A world-record statement is prohibited until an independent party reproduces the pinned experiment, all positive and negative conformance tests pass, the exact grammar/capsule and implementation revisions are digested, and the project wins the same predeclared ledger on at least two task families and two unseen partner pairings against terse English, minified JSON/schema, clean-room PACT with full-history TextMAS, AutoForm, AGP and RADAR where topology is in scope, and the best enabled fallback. Claims must be lane-specific, never global.
